required: A positively completed same-generation Formal/feature scan; infrastructure failure or staged/recovered scan without parent-generation proof is UNKNOWN.
Parent feature-universe row count is explicit and reconciles to the sum of exceptionInputCoverage COMPLETE+PARTIAL+ABSENT.
History/source admission for the parent CURRENT_FEATURE_ROWS is positively complete under the active history-source revalidation contract; stale/unknown parent history blocks the date.

All three exact reject-reason x price-pool population cells are explicit, including zero cells; omitted keys must not be silently interpreted as zero unless the schema explicitly defines that convention.
belowPrimaryMinTotal reconciles with COMPLETE+PARTIAL+ABSENT below-min coverage cells.
Every bounded reject cohort reports population count, sample count, deterministic sampling rule/version and sampling fraction.
Spread/depth field presence is reported as coverage, not interpreted as executable quality; missing spread/depth remains missingness evidence.
No D1/D3/D5/D10/D20/MFE/MAE is joined until the selection-time parent/denominator receipt is accepted CLEAN.

exceptionPassPositiveControlAudit.frozenSpec: research/liquidity_gate_rejected_control_spec_v0_1.json lists LIQ_LOW_VOLUME_EXCEPTION_PASS as a descriptive positive control.
exceptionPassPositiveControlAudit.currentPR121Implementation: Counts liquidityExceptionPass by GENERAL/THOUSAND in exceptionPassCounts, but exactReasons and samples contain only the three rejected cohorts.
exceptionPassPositiveControlAudit.implication: The prototype can measure aggregate exception-pass incidence but cannot currently form a dedicated per-symbol matched positive-control sample for later path/cost comparisons.
exceptionPassPositiveControlAudit.whyNotPatchIntoLegacyRowsBlindly: Legacy Shadow uses a single cohort plus `used`; adding exception-pass rows there can either steal another semantic membership or become conditioned on whether the symbol was sampled elsewhere. That would recreate the quota-conditioned membership problem already falsified for BROAD_CONTROL.
exceptionPassPositiveControlAudit.safeRepairDirection: If a positive-control sample is needed, sample it independently from the frozen below-min+exception-pass frame using an overlapping membership/sidecar structure, not the legacy mutually-exclusive `rows` cohort slot.
exceptionPassPositiveControlAudit.engineeringBoundary: Pure independent sample computation is Class A; durable overlapping membership/shared persistence is Class B proposal-first.

additionalPrototypeGap.rejectPopulationZeroCells: populationCounts is lazily initialized only when a reason is observed. A clean promotion-grade receipt should carry explicit zero values for every preregistered reason x pool or explicitly version the omission-as-zero convention.
additionalPrototypeGap.currentInterpretation: Until repaired/contracted, missing reason key is schema ambiguity rather than a promotion-grade observed zero.

outcomeFirewall: Do not compare rejected vs exception-pass outcomes on a date that fails parent acceptance.
Do not treat exceptionInputCoverage COMPLETE as proof spread/depth source is PIT-valid or economically reliable.
Do not choose lot/amount/spread/depth thresholds after seeing outcomes.
Use scanDate as the independent unit; bounded rows do not create independent denominator dates.
